statement: Ubhayachari Yoga (planets flanking the Sun on both the 2nd and 12th houses) is traditionally read as carrying good name, fame, and elevated social standing — the combined, strongest form of the Sun's flanking yogas.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
